d:
Dilli men yamuna kinare chhath ki taiyariyan jald shuru hongi. magar abhi kuchh jaghon par yamuna men jhag nazar aa raha hai.
Aise men bibisi ke lie kalpana yamuna kinare pahunchin aur dekha ki abhi kya hain halat...
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
